component.name: GitHub Copilot
component.summary: Agent-native desktop app for GitHub Copilot

description.p: The GitHub Copilot app is GitHub's desktop client for running, steering and landing agent work across GitHub repositories. Each local session runs in its own git worktree, and cloud sessions continue in GitHub-hosted environments.
This is an unofficial Flatpak package. The application itself is downloaded from GitHub's official release when the Flatpak is installed.
